_README: Triage flags for the photo Labels column. Each key is a flag name; each value is a list of Apple scene/object labels that raise that flag. Matching is exact (case-insensitive) against the individual labels Apple's on-device classifier produced. Edit freely and reload the case to apply. NOTE: these are review-prioritisation aids only, NOT detection — Apple does not classify drugs or abuse material, so those cannot be found this way. The 'Minor (face)' flag is derived separately from the face-age estimate and means a face was estimated as Baby/Child; it is a prompt for human review, not a finding.
